description: React component definitions for a notes application's UI, including Header, NoteList, NoteItem, NoteEditorModal, FloatingActionButton, LoadingSpinner, and ErrorBanner.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Renders the header section with app title and subtitle.

methods.name: NoteList
methods.description: Displays a list of notes or a message if no notes are present.

methods.name: NoteItem
methods.description: Represents a single note item with edit and delete actions.

methods.name: FloatingActionButton
methods.description: Button to create a new note.

methods.name: NoteEditorModal
methods.description: Modal dialog for creating or editing a note, with loading and error states.

methods.name: ErrorBanner
methods.description: Displays an error message with optional retry button.
